title: Hushed Smoky Dutch Kombu Stew
description: A briny, springy stew that blends the umami of dasima kombu with a subtle smoked flavor, perfect for a low calorie solo dinner.
instructions: Soak the dasima kombu sheets in cold water for 10 minutes, then drain and tear into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a splash of oil in a mini cocotte over medium heat and sauté the diced onions and carrots until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and smoked paprika, cooking for another minute while stirring constantly to avoid burning.
Stir in the tomato paste until it darkens to a deep mahogany color, then pour in the vegetable broth and water, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the torn kombu pieces and reduce the heat to low, covering the cocotte and simmering for 20 minutes to develop the briny, smoky flavor.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste, then stir in the chopped parsley, allowing it to wilt for 2 minutes.
Serve the stew hot directly from the mini cocotte into individual bowls, garnishing with an extra sprinkle of parsley if desired.
